run_train: run the train function to train a SlowFast video classification model for multiple epochs with config
run_train_epoch: run train_epoch to perform one epoch of video model training with optimizer and loss function
run_eval_epoch: run eval_epoch to evaluate the video model on a validation dataset and log metrics
build_trainer: build a trainer with model, optimizer, data loaders, and meters from a SlowFast config
run_precise_bn: run calculate_and_update_precise_bn to update batch normalization stats using precise statistics from training data
